units.source_text: 普通斑蝥的前腿，黑黑细细的，看起来相当敏捷。

en.t: The front legs of an ordinary blister beetle are black and slender, and look quite nimble.

units.source_text: 可这条虫的前腿，像罩上了一层厚厚的套子。

en.t: But the front legs of this insect looked as if they were covered with a thick sheath.

units.source_text: 微微隆起，似隐似现地泛起黄色。

en.t: They bulged slightly, with a faint yellow showing through here and there.

units.source_text: 当然也可能是沾上了花粉。

en.t: Of course, it might simply have been pollen stuck to them.

units.source_text: 但即便如此，也可以使人充分地想象，总有什么道具能使花粉黏附在腿上的吧——譬如毛之类的东西。

en.t: But even so, it was enough to make one imagine that there must be some device that made pollen adhere to the legs, something like hairs, for example.

units.source_text: 如果他的观察没错的话，这该是一项十分了不起的发现。

en.t: If his observation was correct, this would be a truly remarkable discovery.
